title: Fibrin-based endothelial-cardiomyocyte co-culture in a microfluidic device
author: Spanjersberg, Klaassen, et al.

steps.title: Prepare coating solutions
steps.instruction: Make gelatin coating for HUVECs (0.1 % w/v) and Matrigel coating for cardiomyocytes (0.1 mg mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Prepare endothelial cells
steps.instruction: Thaw GFP‑labelled HUVECs (passage ≤7) and keep on ice until coating is ready.

steps.title: Prepare cardiomyocytes
steps.instruction: Thaw hiPSC‑derived cardiomyocytes, keep on ice, and plan for recovery before co‑culture.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make stock solutions of thrombin, fibrinogen and VEGF165 as described in the reagents list.

steps.title: Clean microfluidic device and tubing
steps.instruction: Sterilize chip channels and perfusion tubing with ethanol, PBS rinses and optional UV.

substeps.instruction: Flush each chip channel with 70 % ethanol, incubate 10 min; rinse twice with sterile PBS; aspirate residual liquid.
Optional: expose chip to germicidal UV for 20 min in a laminar flow hood.
Flush tubing with 70 % ethanol, ensure 10 min contact; immerse all other perfusion components in 70 % ethanol for 10 min.
Thoroughly flush tubing and components with sterile PBS, rinse twice with PBS, then remove PBS from all hollow parts.
Apply gentle positive pressure with filtered gas or gently aspirate to avoid air pockets.

steps.title: Thaw and expand cardiomyocytes
steps.instruction: Recover and culture cardiomyocytes in Matrigel‑coated flasks before gel loading.

substeps.instruction: Prepare cardiomyocyte recovery and culture media (RPMI 1640 + B27 Plus 1:50 + pen‑strep 1:100; add 2 µM CHIR99021 fresh if expansion is desired) and pre‑warm to 37 °C.
Coat a T75 flask with Matrigel at 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ for ≥30 min at 37 °C.
Quickly thaw the cryovial in a 37 °C water bath, dilute in warm RPMI, centrifuge 200 × g for 3 min, and resuspend pellet in recovery medium.
Remove Matrigel solution from the flask, add the cell suspension, and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
After 24 h replace with cardiomyocyte culture medium; change medium every 2–3 days until co‑culture initiation.

steps.title: Thaw and expand HUVECs
steps.instruction: Recover and culture HUVECs in gelatin‑coated flasks before gel loading.

substeps.instruction: Coat a T75 flask with 3 mL of 0.1 % gelatin for ≥30 min at 37 °C.
Quickly thaw the HUVEC vial in a 37 °C water bath until only a small frozen piece remains; dilute DMSO into pre‑warmed 15 mL EGM‑2.
Remove gelatin solution, add the cell suspension, and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Replace medium after 24 h and then every 2–3 days; keep passage number ≤7 and avoid full confluency.

steps.title: Prepare cardiomyocyte culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix RPMI 1640 with B27 Plus (1:50), penicillin‑streptomycin (1:100) and, if expanding, add 2 µM CHIR99021 (2.5 µL of 40 mM stock) for a final volume of 50 mL; store at 4 °C ≤1 week.

steps.title: Prepare cardiomyocyte replating medium
steps.instruction: Combine RPMI 1640, KOSR (1:10), B27 Plus (1:50), RevitaCell (1:100) and pen‑strep (1:100) to 50 mL; prepare fresh on day of use.

steps.title: Prepare endothelial cell medium
steps.instruction: Supplement EBM‑2 basal medium with EGM‑2 SingleQuots; optionally add pen‑strep (1:100). Store at 4 °C ≤1 month.

steps.title: Prepare co‑culture recovery medium
steps.instruction: Mix EGM‑2 and cardiomyocyte replating medium 1:1 (v/v) just before use.

steps.title: Prepare co‑culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix EGM‑2 and cardiomyocyte culture medium 1:1 (v/v) to ~45 mL, add VEGF165 12.5 µL of 100 µg mL⁻¹ stock (final 25 ng mL⁻¹) and aprotinin 166.7 µL (1:300, giving 0.01–0.07 TIU mL⁻¹); bring to ~50 mL and use fresh.

steps.title: Prepare permeabilization solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g BSA in 100 mL PBS (5 % w/v) at 4 °C, then add 300 µL Triton X‑100 (0.3 % v/v) and mix until homogeneous; store at 4 °C ≤1 week.

steps.title: Fix samples in chip
steps.instruction: Remove tubing, aspirate medium, rinse twice with Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺‑free PBS, introduce 4 % PFA for 15 min at 20–25 °C, then flush three times with 800 µL PBS; store chips at 4 °C with reservoirs attached or sealed.

steps.title: Permeabilize and block
steps.instruction: Introduce permeabilization solution (5 % BSA, 0.3 % Triton X‑100 in PBS) into channels and incubate 60 min at 20–25 °C.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute anti‑α‑actinin‑2 1:200 in five‑fold diluted permeabilization solution (1 % BSA, 0.06 % Triton), spin 10 min, add 200 µL per chip, incubate 24 h at 4 °C in a humidified rocker.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash chips three times with 400 µL PBS for 30 min each at 4 °C.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute donkey anti‑mouse Alexa Fluor 568 1:400 in five‑fold diluted permeabilization solution, spin 10 min, add 200 µL per chip, incubate 48 h (or overnight) at 4 °C in the dark in a humidified rocker.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash chips twice with 400 µL PBS for 30 min each at 4 °C.

steps.title: Nuclear counterstain
steps.instruction: Dilute DAPI 1:1000 in 200 µL PBS, incubate chips 15 min at 20–25 °C, then wash once with 400 µL PBS for 30 min at 4 °C.
